planets.name: TOI-1438 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1438 with a 9.43-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-1438 c was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-1438. Its orbit and size follow Persson et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
